## Ruling recorded · #30157 mail-verified landing · option A

The maintainer (Yibo Wang) answered the dev's decision card in the project card thread on 2026-11-05T03:06Z, choosing the first option. The card, verbatim as they read it:

> 移动端注册时,验证邮件里的链接应该把人带到哪里?
> 选定:「回 App 提示页」 —— 落到「邮箱已确认,请回 App 登录」页,不在打开邮件的浏览器发令牌;回 App 再登录一次即完成,任何设备都不走死路。

**Ruling: A.** The verification mail's link for a hand-off sign-up lands on a Console page saying the address is confirmed and to go back to the app; no one-time token is minted in the browser that opened the mail. Not chosen: B (`/login` carrying the hand-off redirect, signs in in the mail browser) and C (plain Console `/login`).

Measured by the dev before the ruling (dev boot, `main` `dfafae81`): today a signed-in mail browser lands on 页面不存在, and a signed-out one is sent by the SPA guard to `/login?redirect=<hand-off>`, de facto option B by accident. The PR implements A and carries `handoff_refused_at` on the three hops the card names. The PR follows on branch `claude/project-thread-yz3rkx`; this is a session-transfer flow, so the maintainer reviews and merges it.
